title.zh: OpenClaw企业版开源：OpenAI内部已用它修Bug、合PR
title.en: OpenClaw企业版开源：OpenAI内部已用它修Bug、合PR

current_state.zh: The OpenClaw Foundation open-sourced OpenClaw Enterprise, an MIT-licensed platform for centrally deploying, permissioning, isolating and auditing long-running AI agents, already used internally by OpenAI and Red Hat but still limited to pilot deployments until 1.0.
current_state.en: The OpenClaw Foundation open-sourced OpenClaw Enterprise, an MIT-licensed platform for centrally deploying, permissioning, isolating and auditing long-running AI agents, already used internally by OpenAI and Red Hat but still limited to pilot deployments until 1.0.
